title: Scroll Map content
description: The complete content of one scroll-map webpart. This file IS the contract between a CMS and the webpart: any CMS that can produce this object can render the webpart, with no CMS-specific code in the webpart itself. WordPress, Drupal, SharePoint and headless adapters all map their own storage onto this shape — see src/adapters/.

sectionTitle.description: Required. The heading on the opening card, and the section's accessible name. A newline is a deliberate line break in the reveal animation.

leadText.description: The introduction, shown on the opening card before the first hotspot. Plain text; one paragraph per line.

closingText.description: Optional. Shown on a final card after the last hotspot. Plain text; one paragraph per line.

map.description: Required. The picture the reader is walked around — a map, floor plan, diagram, anything.

hotspots.description: Ordered. Array order is scroll order, and the on-card numbering is derived from it.

options.description: Everything optional. A CMS may omit this entirely.

focal.description: Which part of the map survives when it is cropped to the screen. x:0 keeps the left edge, 100 the right.

theme.description: Design tokens. Emitted as CSS custom properties scoped to the section, so a page may hold several instances with different themes.

image.description: additionalProperties is open on purpose: a CMS may carry its own id, srcset, focal point or rendition data alongside, and the webpart will ignore what it does not know.

alt.description: Alt text. Empty is allowed but always warned about.

srcset.description: Optional. Passed straight through to the .

sizes.description: Optional. Passed straight through to the .

box.description: The highlighted region, as PERCENTAGES OF THE MAP IMAGE — never pixels. That is what makes one set of coordinates correct at every viewport size and for every rendition the CMS serves.

id.description: Stable key. Survives reordering; useful for deep links.

label.description: Short place name. Shown on the badge over the map and in the jump-to bar.

title.description: The card heading. Newlines are line breaks in the reveal.

text.description: The card body as HTML, limited to p, br, em, strong, u and a[href|target|rel]. Anything else is stripped by the renderer — and should also be stripped by the CMS on save.

caption.description: Sits under the image. Photo credit goes here.

side.description: Which half of the screen the TEXT occupies. The map always zooms the hotspot into the other half, which is what guarantees the text can never cover it.

zoom.description: How hard the camera pushes in on this hotspot.

badge.description: Optional pill under the title, e.g. a status.

badgeLevel.description: Badge colour: neutral, green, amber, coral.
